messages.content: What is the largest planet in the universe?

function.name: space_star_info
function.description: Retrieve information about a particular star in the universe. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

information.description: The type of information needed about the star.

message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5 × Jupiter’s radius** (about 180,000 km). Its mass is estimated to be around 10–20 M_J, making it one of the most massive planets ever found.

There are also very large exoplanet candidates, such as **HD 106906 b**, which may have a radius of up to ~11 R_J, but its status as a planet versus a brown dwarf is still debated.
